title: Seacrest Beach "The Chill Out" 27 Blue Dolphin Court
h1: Seacrest Beach "The Chill Out" 27 Blue Dolphin Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Minutes from Rosemary Beach shopping & dining- 4 adult bikes- Balconies off every bedroom- Access to Seacrest community pool- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Discover The Chill Out, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Seacrest Beach home that welcomes 10 guests for a laid-back escape. This beautiful 30A community offers a thriving town center, nature trails, and family-friendly community events. Enjoy unwinding on the home’s sprawling porches, taking advantage of the community’s enormous lagoon-style pool, or relaxing on the white sand beach—only a short stroll away!Tucked along a palm-lined road, this 3-story home is a stunning example of classic, coastal elegance. Step inside to find seagrass, starfish, and other beach accents paired with traditional furnishings, charming wainscoting, and plenty of natural light. The bright living space beckons guests to gather on the soft couch, loveseat, and 2 armchairs, all set around the TV for movie nights filled with laughter and popcorn. The chef’s kitchen is centrally located, with high-end appliances for easy culinary creation and 2 breakfast bars with 3 stools on either side. On the opposite end of the great room, the dining table seats 6 for meals.The second level features 2 primary bedrooms, each with a king bed and a private bathroom. All the home’s bedrooms have balcony access to enjoy the pristine Gulf weather. In the hallway, a laundry closet with a washer and dryer side-by-side offers convenience.Continue to the third level, where a guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds offer additional sleeping accommodations, great for kids or guests who love socializing. Each of the room’s spacious covered balconies include comfortable seating and alfresco tables, encouraging guests to spend time outside savoring the balmy breeze.With ample outdoor space and Seacrest Beach’s wonderful amenities, The Chill Out is a perfect escape for a carefree 30A getaway. Parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway makes it easy to explore or hop on the 4 complimentary bikes and cruise to Rosemary Beach forshopping and dining. Beach access is directly south of the Lagoon Pool, located at The Villas at Sunset Beach. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Second Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

DETAILS: Discover The Chill Out, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Seacrest Beach home that welcomes 10 guests for a laid-back escape. This beautiful 30A community offers a thriving town center, nature trails, and family-friendly community events. Enjoy unwinding on the home’s sprawling porches, taking advantage of the community’s enormous lagoon-style pool, or relaxing on the white sand beach—only a short stroll away! Tucked along a palm-lined road, this 3-story home is a stunning example of classic, coastal elegance. Step inside to find seagrass, starfish, and other beach accents paired with traditional furnishings, charming wainscoting, and plenty of natural light. The bright living space beckons guests to gather on the soft couch, loveseat, and 2 armchairs, all set around the TV for movie nights filled with laughter and popcorn. The chef’s kitchen is centrally located, with high-end appliances for easy culinary creation and 2 breakfast bars with 3 stools on either side. On the opposite end of the great room, the dining table seats 6 for meals. The second level features 2 primary bedrooms, each with a king bed and a private bathroom. All the home’s bedrooms have balcony access to enjoy the pristine Gulf weather. In the hallway, a laundry closet with a washer and dryer side-by-side offers convenience. Continue to the third level, where a guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds offer additional sleeping accommodations, great for kids or guests who love socializing. Each of the room’s spacious covered balconies include comfortable seating and alfresco tables, encouraging guests to spend time outside savoring the balmy breeze. With ample outdoor space and Seacrest Beach’s wonderful amenities, The Chill Out is a perfect escape for a carefree 30A getaway. Parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway makes it easy to explore or hop on the 4 complimentary bikes and cruise to Rosemary Beach for shopping and dining. Beach access is directly south of the Lagoon Pool, located at The Villas at Sunset Beach. Book today!
